visual_requirements.description: dignified mature Egyptian goddess, human female form, one head two arms two legs, fully opaque heavy linen robe and plain gold collar, brass sistrum held clearly
Physical sea winds governed by her will bend spray away from the foreground; protectress of sailors, no generic magic glow
stormy sea shoreline, based on her protection of sailors

source_claims.quote: This statuette shows the goddess in her most beloved pose, nursing her son Horus (known also as the lactans pose).

statement.id: Sebuah patung kecil menunjukkan Isis menyusui putranya Horus.
statement.en: A statuette shows Isis nursing Horus.

source_claims.quote: Her symbols are the scorpion (who kept her safe when she was in hiding), the kite (a kind of falcon whose shape she assumed in bringing her husband back to life), the empty throne, and the sistrum.

statement.id: Lambang Isis adalah kalajengking (yang menjaganya saat bersembunyi), kite (sejenis elang yang wujudnya ia ambil untuk menghidupkan suaminya), takhta kosong, dan sistrum.
statement.en: Isis's symbols are the scorpion (who kept her safe in hiding), the kite (a kind of falcon whose shape she assumed in bringing her husband back to life), the empty throne, and the sistrum.

source_claims.quote: Eventually, she became associated with the sea and was a protectress of sailors and merchants who wore talismans honoring her and invoked her aid in times of trouble (attested to by archaeological evidence).

statement.id: Isis akhirnya dikaitkan dengan laut dan menjadi pelindung pelaut dan pedagang yang memakai jimat untuknya dan memohon bantuannya saat bahaya.
statement.en: Isis eventually became associated with the sea and was protectress of sailors and merchants who wore talismans honoring her and invoked her aid in times of trouble.

source_claims.quote: She is regularly portrayed as the selfless, giving, mother, wife, and protectress, who places other's interests and well-being ahead of her own.

statement.id: Isis biasanya digambarkan sebagai ibu, istri, dan pelindung yang tanpa pamrih, murah hati, dan mengutamakan kepentingan orang lain.
statement.en: Isis is regularly portrayed as a selfless, giving mother, wife, and protectress who puts others' interests and well-being ahead of her own.

source_claims.quote: at my will the planets of the ayre, the wholesome winds of the Seas, and the silences of hell be diposed
source_claims.locator: Book 11, the goddess speaks to Lucius

statement.id: Sang dewi dalam karya Apuleius menyatakan bahwa atas kehendaknya planet-planet langit, angin laut yang menyehatkan, dan kesunyian neraka diatur.
statement.en: In Apuleius's work the goddess declares that at her will the planets of the air, the wholesome winds of the seas, and the silences of hell are disposed.

source_claims.quote: Isis's Greek devotees ascribed to her traits taken from Greek deities, such as the invention of marriage and the protection of ships at sea.

statement.id: Para pemuja Yunani Isis mengaitkan dengannya sifat dari dewa Yunani, seperti penemuan pernikahan dan perlindungan kapal di laut.
statement.en: Isis's Greek devotees ascribed to her traits taken from Greek deities, such as the invention of marriage and the protection of ships at sea.

artistic_choices: Palette, camera, age details, opaque clothing embellishment and unspecific staging are editorial choices, not additional source facts.
Dominance through close framing and foreshortening unless source documents scale.
No outward power added beyond documented domain; weather, light and debris remain physically grounded.

SETTING: stormy sea shoreline, based on her protection of sailors [isis-c15, isis-c52]
MOOD: overwhelming, imposing, active, dignified where divine; never cute, placid or decorative. Original mythology art, no borrowed modern character designs.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: NO text, letters, pseudo-writing, glyphs, runes, logos, signatures or decorative script anywhere including clothing, weapons, architecture. NO border, frame, watermark, extra heads, limbs or fingers. Fully opaque clothing, no nudity, sexualization, explicit gore. No generic aura, neon outline, glowing mist or energy ribbons. Do not print claim IDs on image.

A simple gold collar is permitted. Her sistrum and protective sea wind are the identifying attributes. Clearly fully opaque densely woven clothing.
